name: Permit2
note: Uniswap's canonical signature-based approval contract. Same address on every EVM chain (CREATE2 vanity deployment — note the address itself is nearly all zero bytes, a deliberately mined vanity prefix). Heavy on EIP-712 typed-data hashing and ecrecover, plus a packed-word nonce bitmap (each storage slot tracks 256 nonces via bit flags) — a genuinely different storage-packing pattern from the Uniswap V2 pair's reserve packing. One of the most-called contracts on mainnet, so failure modes here are directly 'what real users will hit'.
